title: AI Assurance Case Lab
description: The capstone of a ten-lab series: an assurance case that turns pinned evidence from AI testing labs into one reviewable release argument, with defeaters, residual risks, mappings to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and checks that test the argument itself.
notes: Code is licensed under MIT; the written material (articles/) is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Orbitly is fictional; evidence comes from teaching labs; framework mappings are not a legal assessment.
